titleEn: All-In Podcast — Elon Musk & Gwynne Shotwell on AI risks, Starship, Terafab and a SpaceX/Tesla merger
titleZh: All-In 播客——埃隆·马斯克与格温·肖特韦尔谈 AI 风险、星舰、Terafab 以及 SpaceX/Tesla 合并
summaryEn: Elon Musk joins Gwynne Shotwell on the All-In Podcast to discuss the real risks of AI and peer review of models, what he meant by “Dario is right”, his working relationship with Shotwell, Starship's future, Terafab, flying cars and a possible merger of Tesla and SpaceX.
